repo.description:
### Summary

`try_files {path}` resolves `/.env/./` to the regular file `/.env`, while path matchers see `/.env/`. A rule such as `path *.env` placed before the rewrite doesn't match, and `file_server` serves the file without its canonical redirect. `php_fastcgi` and FrankenPHP's `php_server` are affected through their built-in try_files route.

### Details

The `file` matcher (`modules/caddyhttp/fileserver/matcher.go`) runs `path.Clean` on each expanded candidate, which drops the trailing slash, and restores it only when the try_files pattern itself ends in `/`. So `try_files {path}` resolves `/.env/./` to the regular file `/.env` and rewrites the request to it.

Path matchers see `/.env/` for that request, so suffix rules, exact paths, globs ending in a file name and `$`-anchored `path_regexp` evaluated before the rewrite don't match. `file_server` then skips its canonical redirect because `path.Base` of the original path (`.`) and of the rewritten path (`.env`) differ, and serves the file.

Fix: keep the trailing slash of the expanded candidate through `path.Clean`. `strictFileExists` already requires a candidate ending in `/` to be a directory, so `/.env/` and `/.env/./` no longer match the regular file, while `/dir/./` still matches the directory and `split_path` keeps working. Patch: public PR from `dunglas:fileserver-match-trailing-slash`.

Discovered by Anthropic's OSS Scanner, as vulnerability ANT-2026-VAGWNYYZ.

### Proof of concept

```caddyfile
:8080 {
	root /srv
	@blocked path *.env
	route {
		respond @blocked 403
		try_files {path} {path}/ /index.html
		file_server
	}
}
```

```console
$ curl -i localhost:8080/.env                        # 403
$ curl -i --path-as-is localhost:8080/.env/./        # 200, body of /srv/.env
```

The same works with `php_fastcgi` followed by `file_server`.

### Impact

Unauthenticated clients read static files (`.env`, backups, configuration) that a suffix or exact path rule is meant to block. Prefix rules and `*/.*` still block. Nothing gets executed.
repo.summary: file matcher resolves /file/./ to a regular file, bypassing suffix path rules
